authorization.status: provisional research screen only; not an assigned competition lane

hypothesis: At some buried normal-fault or basement-contact boundaries, gravity and magnetic gradient ridges may be displaced coherently from the detrended-elevation gradient at 300 m and 800 m smoothing scales. A cross-sensor, cross-scale lag-coherence score may therefore recover withheld fault segments more often than a probability-mass-matched uniform null.
mechanism: For each of the cached detrended-elevation, isostatic-gravity-anomaly and total-magnetic-intensity layers, robust-scale values using footprint-only median/MAD. Compute scale-normalized Gaussian gradient vectors at sigma 3 and 8 pixels. At each scale, compare absolute gradient-vector cosine alignment of gravity and magnetic gradients shifted by one of eight 3-pixel cardinal/diagonal offsets against zero-shift alignment with the elevation gradient. Retain positive alignment gain only; combine gravity and magnetic gains only when their preferred offsets agree, and require offset-direction consistency between scales. Weight by the geometric mean of the local 300 m-scale gradient magnitudes for all three fields, each clipped after division by its footprint-only 99th percentile. Normalize the nonnegative response by its footprint-only 99th percentile and clip to [0,1]. No catalogue, registry, labels, or site score enters feature construction.
named_non_fault_mimics: Cenozoic dike swarms and intrusive contacts

holdout.split: four spatial quadrants; whole 8-connected catalogue components withheld; 12 px quadrant-boundary erosion; 3 px feature-context buffer around withheld components
holdout.catalogue_derived_features: none; all candidate features are independent cached rasters

uncertainty.method: shared paired spatial-block bootstrap over evaluator additive terms

holdout.control: uniform probability within each fold's active evaluation region, set to the candidate surface's mean probability in that same region

leakage_canary.failure_rule: If any fold-specific two-sided ROC AUC (max(AUC,1-AUC)) exceeds 0.90, treat as leakage until resolved; do not interpret DTI or promote.

uniqueness.indexed_registry: registry/registry.json; 179 unique restored rasters from 231 immutable public-owner source rows; 0 rejected
uniqueness.scope_limit: indexed public owner repositories only; not a complete organizer registry
phases: final dots only if pre-placement screen passes

expected_direction: Qualitatively positive versus the probability-mass-matched uniform null if the geological mechanism generalizes; no numerical DTI or leaderboard projection is preregistered.
stop_and_artifact_policy: Run the feature-only leakage canaries and one shared spatial holdout screen. Write only the continuous research surface with the shared submission writer; do not emit final dots unless the pre-placement uniqueness gate passes. Any failed gate produces a negative run card. Never select or spend a competition slot.
